answer: Self-funding audit bounties are a concrete sybil brake: anyone who proves an account fake with on-chain evidence claims a slice of that account locked stake and future emissions, so hunting sybils pays better than running them. Investigators comb the ledger like an orchard in fruit season, each conviction a felled timber of bad wood, and the reward pool needs no new funding since it is the attackers own collateral. A farm facing thousands of bounty hunters pays defense on every head, while the ocean of honest accounts is never worth probing. The attack funds its own defeat.
